english.title: Political parties - non individual donor fail to report multiple small donations

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: POLITICAL PARTIES ELECTIONS AND REFERENDUMS ACT 2000

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a donor who has made, during the course of a calendar year, small donations to a registered party, namely **(..SPECIFY PARTY..), whose aggregate value was more than £5000, namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT..), delivered to the Electoral Commission a report of your donations which did not comply with Section 68(2) of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000 in that it

(A)_[failed to give the aggregate value of the donations and the year in which they were made]_
(B)_[failed to give the name of the registered party to whom they were made]_
(C)_[failed to give any details as are required by paragraph 2 of Schedule 6 to the Act concerning the identity of the donor]_
english.legislation:
Contrary to section 68(5)(a) of and Schedule 20 to the
Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 68(6) for definition of "small donation".
(ii) See Offence Wording H3591 for individual donor

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: One year imprisonment or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
